integrity: The mathematical proof is elementary but complete: symmetry reduces odd degrees to one angular sector, exact chord-edge intersections determine both boundary arcs, and a strict one-variable trigonometric inequality gives all equality directions. The new finding is neither independently audited nor externally certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to regular Euclidean polygons and measures only the polygonal boundary arcs, not the perimeters of the cut-off regions including their cutting chords.
The triangular specialization is prior work; the claimed new content is the all-odd-degree exact directional law, equality classification, and asymptotic profile.
Source comparisons cannot exclude unindexed or inaccessible historical treatments of regular-polygon boundary partition.
Finite computational checks corroborate but do not establish the analytic all-degree result.
title: Exact directional perimeter Winternitz law for regular polygons
